title: Integrated Harness
description: The harness combines system instructions, tools, memory, teams, background work, cron, worktrees, and MCP.

steps.content: Prepare this project for release. Check the code, update the docs, and report deployment readiness.
steps.annotation: One ordinary request needs several earlier capabilities to work together.

steps.content: assemble_prompt: memory + task graph + skills + available tools + policy
steps.annotation: The runtime builds the prompt from layered sources of context.

steps.content: I suggest a docs teammate while I run the release checks and inspect deployment status. Shall I start that team?
steps.annotation: The Lead proposes the team before adding another persistent agent.

steps.content: Yes. Start the docs teammate and continue.
steps.annotation: User confirmation opens the team boundary inherited from S13.
Skills contribute procedural context before execution.

steps.content: {"subject":"Update release notes","description":"Prepare release documentation and report the result."}
steps.annotation: The shared task board gives the docs work a stable owner and lifecycle.
The task ID connects the assignment to its working directory.
The pending docs task receives a separate checkout before it is claimed.
The task now carries the checkout used by its eventual owner.

steps.content: {"name":"docs","role":"documentation engineer","prompt":"Claim task_1712345678_0042, update the release notes in its task-bound worktree, and report the result."}
steps.annotation: Team delegation handles a parallel slice of the release.
Long-running validation goes through the background task path.

steps.content: permission: user approved the exact test command
steps.annotation: Team confirmation does not authorize shell execution; the foreground turn asks separately before dispatch.
External capabilities are added only when needed.
Connecting discovers the tool; a separate call performs the status check.
The readiness statement now comes from the MCP tool result rather than the connection event.

steps.content: task_notification(status=completed): tests passed; teammate result and deploy status appended
steps.annotation: The integrated runtime folds asynchronous results back into the loop.

steps.content: Release preparation is ready: checks passed, docs are updated in the teammate worktree, and deployment status is available.
steps.annotation: The integrated harness returns a single user-facing outcome.
